Content Layer types

Response

Response of a data request.

Available as lseg.data.content.Response.

Syntax

Response(
    is_success: bool,
    raw: list[httpx.Response] | httpx.Response,
    errors: list[Error],
    closure: str | None,
    requests_count: int,
    _data_factory: BaseDataFactory,
    _kwargs: dict,
    _data_raw: Any,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
is_success bool Yes Indicates whether the request was successful.
raw list[httpx.Response] | httpx.Response Yes Raw HTTP response, or a list of raw responses if the data was retrieved with several requests.
errors list[Error] Yes Errors that occurred while processing the request.
closure str | None Yes Closure value passed with the request and returned in the response.
requests_count int Yes Number of requests that were made to get the response.
